name: RivuletDerived
title: Rivulet derived concepts
description: Concepts Rivulet derives from resident observations that the OneAquaHealth IG code system has no code for. Not endorsed by the OneAquaHealth consortium.

concept.definition: Forel-Ule colour index (1-21) — no OAH code for water colour
WFD-named indicative status class — no OAH code for the classified outcome; not an official WFD classification
Rivulet data confidence (0-1) — no OAH code for evidence strength
Visual clarity reported by a resident (0 clear to 3 opaque) — not a suspended-solids measurement, so not OAH tss
Sewage odour reported by a resident — a possible sign of faecal contamination, not a coliform count
Green algae or surface scum seen — not a macrophyte survey
Foam on the water surface seen by a resident
Dead fish seen by a resident
Visible litter on the margins (0 none to 3 a lot) — not a land-use classification

Sum of BMWP-family sensitivity values for the recognisable animal groups a resident reports (1-10 per group) — a simplified proxy, not the OneAquaHealth benthic macroinvertebrate count and not a BMWP protocol score
Flow as a resident sees it, 0 still to 3 fast — not a hydromorphological survey, so not the OneAquaHealth hydrology concept
Indicative concern for people, dogs and wildlife near a stream, from recent resident-reported warning signs and nearby places people use — a prompt to take care, not a public-health assessment
Indicative class named high; not an official WFD classification
Indicative class named good; not an official WFD classification
Indicative class named moderate; not an official WFD classification
Indicative class named poor; not an official WFD classification
Indicative class named bad; not an official WFD classification
